hints: Focus on what actually controls the shape and position of a Boltzmann curve at a fixed temperature.
Remember that a catalyst works by providing a different reaction pathway, so think about which energy value this changes.
Connect the unchanged particle energies with the new pathway to see what happens to the position of X and the area beyond it.
walkthrough:
**Understand the Boltzmann curve**

Think of the curve as a snapshot of how energy is shared out between particles. At the same temperature, the average energy and the spread of energies stay exactly the same.

So the shape of the curve and the position of the peak do not change unless temperature changes.

**Recall what a catalyst does**

A catalyst does not give particles more energy and it does not change temperature. It provides an alternative route with a lower activation energy, $E_a$.

In simple terms, it lowers the energy hurdle that particles must clear to react.

**Apply this to the diagram**

Because temperature is unchanged, the distribution curve stays where it is. Only the activation energy marker, X, moves to a lower energy value to the left.

This means a larger area under the curve is now to the right of X, so many more particles have $E \ge E_a$ and the rate increases.

options.A: This describes heating, not catalysis. Higher temperature gives more particles higher values of E and changes the curve shape. A catalyst at the same temperature leaves particle energies unchanged.
options.B: The peak position (most probable energy) depends only on temperature. At the same temperature the peak stays in the same place. Students sometimes confuse a lower Ea with the whole curve shifting left.
options.C: The peak moves to the right and flattens when temperature is increased. A catalyst does not heat the mixture, so it does not shift the peak to the right.
options.D: Correct. An effective catalyst provides an alternative mechanism with a lower activation energy. On the diagram X moves left, while the Boltzmann distribution itself is unchanged because temperature is constant.
